Origin and meaning

Isabella is a Hebrew name meaning “pledged to God (form of Elizabeth)”.

About the name Isabella

A Spanish and Italian form of Elizabeth, carried by queens of Castile.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Isabella carries the meaning “pledged to God (form of Elizabeth)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
